en: An old Russian Empire postal stationery reply postcard with a printed red imperial double-headed eagle crest on the upper left and red pre-printed 3‑kopeck stamp on the upper right. The heading in red Russian text reads "ОТКРЫТОЕ ПИСЬМО ДЛЯ ОТВЕТА". The card is filled with black handwritten script in German, addressed to a Dr. Frank in Pernau. Several black circular postmarks with Cyrillic text and dates are stamped over the card and stamp. Additional small handwritten numbers and notations appear around the edges.
